Initially released for the 2010 World Cup in South Africa, the Adidas Jabulani remains the most controversial soccer ball ever made… BUT, that definitely does not make it the worst. In fact, I’d argue the opposite: of all the footballs I’ve played with, none were as fun to use the Jabulani.  The only reason people claim this ball wasn’t good is because professional players didn’t like it. In reality, they just didnt know how to use it.. Except for one man—Diego Forlan. Three months before the tournament, Adidas sent him the ball to practice with. After learning it’s unique physics, he went on to have one of the best individual performances in World Cup history, winning both the golden boot, and player of the tournament awards (5 goals) as he led Uruguay to a fourth place finish. Turns out, the Jabulani is good. You just needed to practice with it 🤯🇺🇾 #football #Soccer #worldcup #sports #footballtiktok #skills #adidas #futbol #goal
